Captured on 2026-09-07 from https://httpbingo.org/websocket/echo and grpcb.in:9001. WebSocket payloads/timestamps and all gRPC wire messages are from real network calls. Unneeded WebSocket handshake headers/cookies were removed; the Fluxy-specific frame extension was removed to exercise Chromium _webSocketMessages import. gRPC response trailers remain separate to exercise trailer import. Protos were exported using grpcurl server reflection. _grpc.decodedResponses stores the decoded wire messages for regression assertions.
Expected decoded message field names use the original .proto spelling (f_string) rather than the capture library’s camelCase (fString).
